blocking.issue: The critic's monthly check never reaches the bar live. No run.changed frame is sent when the check starts or when it ends, so the UI shows it only after a reload or reconnect, and then keeps showing it, with Stop, after it has ended.
blocking.evidence: The poke listens only to the 'session' and 'project' buses and wraps scheduler.requestStart and cancelPending. CalibrationJob emits nothing on any bus. Probe (/tmp/frbench/review-d1109-run-visible/probes/README.txt, a composed runtime with a gated provider): while the check's first critic call was held, GET /running returned ["Forerunner · the critic's monthly check on known examples"], but rt.events received zero run.changed frames during the check (2.5 s) and after it ended. The UI re-reads /running only at bootstrap, when the stream reopens, or in polling mode (context.tsx). The real-daemon case reads GET /running directly, and the UI case uses the fake daemon's emitRunning(), so neither catches this. This is spec V-1/V-2 ('while the critic's calibration runs it reads ...', 'the UI shows it in the open form') and the owner's answer 6: 'show it in the running-session bar'.
